assertions: typed import creates ParsedImport and ParsedItems
missing-date work is flagged needsReview without an invented date
Add All conversion is idempotent by assignment id
failed parse can transition to retrying with preserved source
recent import rebuilds the correct review draft
camera asset creates a photo ParsedImport without pretending OCR succeeded
document asset creates a PDF ParsedImport
permission-denied is UI-only and not persisted as a parser status
large and unsupported files return useful errors

truthfulness.ocr: Camera and image uploads require the configured OCR parser endpoint. Local fallback stays honest and does not claim image extraction.
truthfulness.typedText: Typed and pasted text parse locally through deterministic syllabus parsing.
truthfulness.pdf: Text-based PDFs parse locally; scanned PDFs require OCR or manual typed confirmation.
